assumptions: 253 laws (23 terms with <= 5 leaves; unordered pairs)
N = 1..12, complete SAT (conflict budget 2,000,000; UNKNOWN recorded)
cofiniteness is only suggested, not proved, by N <= 12
meta.falsification: A law whose spectrum up to 12 is neither {1} nor of the form 'all N >= n0 plus a set of small N' (e.g. a law with models exactly at the even sizes).
meta.hypothesis: H-C13-5 (bold): every one-variable law has anchored spectrum {1} or a cofinite set (all N beyond some bound), because such a law only constrains the orbit of each element under its own diagonal maps.
meta.methodology: MagmaSAT with the anchor for every law and N; divisor-closure violations (N, d); spectra patterns; affine roots for comparison.
meta.question: For every law t1(x) = t2(x) with t1 != t2 one-variable terms of at most 5 leaves, which N <= 12 admit an anchored model? Which spectra violate divisor-closure, and is every spectrum either {1} or cofinite?
meta.title: Spectra of one-variable laws and the failure of divisor-closure

summary: 253 one-variable laws; spectrum {1}: 9; models for every N in 7..12: 237; other: 7 ['x = (xx)x', 'x = ((xx)x)x', 'x = (((xx)x)x)x', 'xx = ((xx)x)x']
divisor-closure violations: 24 e.g. [('x = x(x(xx))', [2]), ('x = x((xx)x)', [2]), ('x = x(((xx)x)x)', [3]), ('xx = (xx)((xx)x)', [2])]
